_comment: The crew as the site shows it: one line per role and when it is usually cast. Keep in step with agents/*.md and skills/showtime/references/crew.md.

roles.name: creative director
roles.line: Pitches three concepts and a wildcard, then signs off the storyboard.

roles.name: brand designer
roles.line: Pulls a brand kit from your repo or site, or proposes one.

roles.name: scriptwriter
roles.line: Writes every word you hear or read, each fact tied to a source.

roles.name: storyboard artist
roles.line: Turns the picked concept into shots, timings and an animatic.

roles.name: motion designer
roles.line: Builds one scene in its own sandbox; several work in parallel.

roles.name: sound designer
roles.line: Music bed, effects on cues, the sound logo and a metered mix.

roles.name: voice director
roles.line: Casting, pronunciation, the voice-over and other languages.

roles.name: editor
roles.line: Cuts real footage by transcript; captions and reframes it.

roles.name: researcher
roles.line: Checks every claim against its source and every asset's license.

roles.name: critic
roles.line: Watches the draft like a stranger: blocker, should-fix, polish.
